    A workshop, not a warehouse

    Every idol on this site starts as a block of seasoned teak. Our karigars rough out the form with a saw, then spend anywhere from a week to two months chiselling the finer relief — the beads of a mala, the feathers of a peacock, the tusks of an elephant — entirely by hand.

    Because nothing here is mass-moulded, sizes and finishes can be adjusted to what your space needs. If you don't see the exact size or wood you want, send us a message and we'll quote it.
